title: Wellbeing check and mock-week plan
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y11 lesson 7 (Wellbeing check and mock-week plan (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 7. This check is private: it is for you. Be honest, then plan your mock week.

model.title: Feedback: 'Lost marks on 6-mark questions; ran out of time.'

parts.text: Target 1: practise one 6-mark question a day
Target 2: timed sections with a clock
Target 3: use the mark scheme to self-mark
Review each target in two weeks

blocks.h: My wellbeing check (1 low to 5 high)

box.title: After the mocks: three specific targets

keywords.def: feeling healthy and able to cope
a practice exam in real conditions

questions.q: Turn 'weak on algebra' into a specific target.
questions.a: For example: 20 minutes of factorising and solving questions three times a week, checked with answers.

questions.q: Core: Complete your private wellbeing check and a one-week plan for the mock week (pupil PDF).
questions.a: An honest check and a plan.

questions.q: Extend: In the portal response box, write how you will use mock feedback. Start: 'When I get my results...'
questions.a: Read feedback, set three targets, plan them into the break.

questions.q: Best use of a disappointing mock?
questions.a: B) Turn feedback into specific targets. Mocks are practice; targets turn them into progress.

questions.q: A mock exam is best seen as... A) a final judgement B) a map for improvement C) unimportant
Big question: judgement or map? Why?
questions.a: A map: it shows strengths and what to improve.
